pages.text: $(bold)Dreadsteel$() (Armor-exclusive trait, Dreadsteel armor parts): Fear descends, and all creatures bow down.$(br2)Effect: While worn, grants Night Vision, Fire Resistance, immunity to frost, and a damage cap (≤ 30 damage per 0.5 seconds).$(br2)Ability: Press the bound key, consuming 5 levels of experience, to unleash $(bold)Dread Field$() — deals multiple hits of damage to creatures within 16 blocks in low light (< 8) over 5 seconds, with a 120-second cooldown.
